newsitem.title: GERMANY: Compuserve says plans tie-up with Deutsche Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Compuserve says plans tie-up with Deutsche Telekom.

text.p: Online service CompuServe plans a cooperation agreement with Deutsche Telekom and will announce details of the deal on Friday, CompuServe said in an invitation to a news conference.
The invitation, received late on Friday, said that the companies would "explain the international significance of the cooperation", but gave no details.
A Deutsche Telekom spokesman declined to comment further.
Telekom's T-Online service is the largest on-line service in Germany. For the last few months it has been working together closely with AOL, Germany's third largest service.
AOL is a joint venture between Bertelsmann AG and America Online.
